```{python}
import base64
import json
import os
import platform
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

import helpers as h  # chart style, and the chart library embedded for offline reading
from provenance import _run, git, sha256

RESULTS = Path(os.environ.get("HEALTH_RESULTS", "."))
profile = json.loads((RESULTS / "profile.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
info = json.loads((RESULTS / "upload.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
checks = pd.read_csv(RESULTS / "checks.csv")
raw = pd.read_csv(RESULTS / "table.csv", low_memory=False)

# Who the report is for, chosen on the home page: the researcher view shows how the table was read
# and every statistic; the public health view leads with what changed and keeps the detail short.
AUDIENCE = os.environ.get("HEALTH_AUDIENCE", "researcher")
RESEARCH = AUDIENCE != "public_health"
TIME, PERIOD, GROUPS = profile["time"], profile["period"], profile["groups"]
MEASURES = {m["name"]: m["how"] for m in profile["measures"]}
COUNTED = {m["name"] for m in profile["measures"] if m.get("counted")}
REAL = [m for m in MEASURES if m not in COUNTED]
MAIN = GROUPS[0] if GROUPS else None
for g in GROUPS:
    raw[g] = raw[g].astype("string").fillna("(empty)")

# The reader's choices on the home page: a range of years and some values of the main group.
YEARS = tuple(int(y) for y in os.environ["HEALTH_YEARS"].split("-")) if os.environ.get("HEALTH_YEARS") else None
CHOSEN = json.loads(os.environ.get("HEALTH_GROUPS") or "null")

table = raw.copy()
if TIME:
    if PERIOD == "year":
        table["_period"] = pd.to_datetime(table[TIME].astype("Int64").astype("string") + "-01-01", errors="coerce")
    else:
        table["_period"] = pd.to_datetime(table[TIME], errors="coerce")
    if PERIOD == "day" and table["_period"].nunique() > 400:  # daily data over years: show months
        PERIOD = "month"
    freq = {"year": "Y", "month": "M", "week": "W", "day": "D"}[PERIOD]
    table["_period"] = table["_period"].dt.to_period(freq).dt.start_time
    if YEARS:
        table = table[table["_period"].dt.year.between(*YEARS)]
if CHOSEN and MAIN:
    table = table[table[MAIN].isin(CHOSEN)]

PALETTE = ["#2a78d6", "#e8743b", "#19a979", "#945ecf", "#d64e8c", "#13a4b4", "#7f6f5f", "#b2a200"]
HOW = {"sum": "added up", "mean": "averaged"}


def label(period) -> str:
    if pd.isna(period):
        return "unknown"
    return {"year": f"{period:%Y}", "month": f"{period:%Y-%m}",
            "week": f"{period.isocalendar()[0]}-W{period.isocalendar()[1]:02d}"}.get(PERIOD, f"{period:%Y-%m-%d}")


def number(x) -> str:
    if pd.isna(x):
        return "–"
    return f"{x:,.0f}" if abs(x) >= 100 or float(x).is_integer() else f"{x:,.2f}"


def percent(new, old) -> str:
    if pd.isna(new) or old is None or pd.isna(old) or old == 0:
        return "–"
    return f"{(new - old) / abs(old) * 100:+.1f}%"


def combine(frame: pd.DataFrame, by, measure: str) -> pd.Series:
    return frame.groupby(by, dropna=True)[measure].agg(MEASURES[measure])


def show(frame: pd.DataFrame):
    styler = frame.style.hide(axis="index").set_properties(**{"text-align": "left", "font-size": "0.92rem"})
    display(HTML(styler.to_html()))


def figure(title: str, y_title: str, height: int = 340) -> go.Figure:
    fig = go.Figure()
    fig.update_layout(**h.LAYOUT, height=height, title=dict(text=title, font=dict(size=15)))
    fig.update_yaxes(title=y_title, gridcolor=h.GRID, showgrid=True, rangemode="tozero")
    return fig


def trend(frame: pd.DataFrame, measure: str):
    total = combine(frame, "_period", measure)
    fig = figure(f"{measure}: {'total' if MEASURES[measure] == 'sum' else 'average'} per {PERIOD}", measure)
    fig.add_scatter(x=[label(p) for p in total.index], y=total.values, mode="lines+markers",
                    line=dict(color=h.BLUE, width=2), name=measure)
    fig.update_xaxes(type="category", nticks=12)
    fig.show()


def ranked(frame: pd.DataFrame, group: str, measure: str, title: str):
    top = combine(frame, group, measure).sort_values(ascending=False).head(15).reset_index()
    h.bar_figure(top, measure, group, title + (" (largest 15)" if len(top) == 15 else ""), measure,
                 height=max(260, 30 * len(top) + 80)).show()


def histogram(frame: pd.DataFrame, measure: str):
    fig = figure(f"Distribution of {measure}", "Rows")
    fig.add_histogram(x=frame[measure].dropna(), marker=dict(color=h.BLUE), nbinsx=30, name=measure)
    fig.update_layout(hovermode="closest", bargap=0.05)
    fig.update_xaxes(title=measure)
    fig.show()


timed = table.dropna(subset=["_period"]) if TIME else table
periods = sorted(timed["_period"].unique()) if TIME else []
span = (f"{label(periods[0])} – {label(periods[-1])}" if len(periods) > 1 else label(periods[0])) if periods else "–"

# Files that go with the report: the rows it used and its summary statistics.
table.drop(columns=[c for c in table.columns if c.startswith("_")]).to_csv("data.csv", index=False)

cards = [(f"{len(table):,}", "rows used"), (f"{len(raw.columns) - len(COUNTED)}", "columns"),
         (f"{len(REAL)}", "number columns"),
         (f"{int(raw.drop(columns=list(COUNTED)).isna().sum().sum()):,}", "missing cells"),
         (span if TIME else "snapshot", f"{PERIOD}s" if TIME else "no time column")]
display(HTML(f'<p><span class="view">{"Researcher view" if RESEARCH else "Public health view"}</span></p>'
             '<div class="summary-grid">' + "".join(
                 f'<div class="summary-card"><div class="value">{v}</div><div class="label">{k}</div></div>'
                 for v, k in cards) + "</div>"))
filters = []
if YEARS:
    filters.append(f"years {YEARS[0]}–{YEARS[1]}")
if CHOSEN and MAIN:
    filters.append(f"{MAIN}: {', '.join(CHOSEN)}")
display(Markdown(
    f"Made from **{info['name']}**, uploaded {info['uploaded_at'][:16].replace('T', ' ')} UTC. "
    + ("This report describes the table as it is: how each column was read, its quality, its statistics and, "
       "when it has a date or year, how its numbers change over time."
       if RESEARCH else
       "This report gives a short overview of the table: what changed most recently, which groups are largest "
       "and how the numbers move over time.")
    + (f"\n\nShowing only: {'; '.join(filters)}." if filters else "")))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
# Public health view: the main points first.
if not RESEARCH:
    print("\n\n## Key points\n")
    first = next(iter(MEASURES))
    points = []
    if TIME and len(periods) > 1:
        total = combine(timed, "_period", first)
        points.append(f"**{first}** in the latest {PERIOD} ({label(total.index[-1])}): **{number(total.iloc[-1])}**, "
                      f"{percent(total.iloc[-1], total.iloc[-2])} against {label(total.index[-2])}.")
        if MAIN:
            by = combine(timed, [MAIN, "_period"], first).unstack(MAIN)
            if len(by.index) > 1:
                change = (by.iloc[-1] - by.iloc[-2]).dropna().sort_values()
                if len(change) and change.iloc[-1] > 0:
                    points.append(f"Largest rise: **{change.index[-1]}** ({'+' + number(change.iloc[-1])}).")
                if len(change) and change.iloc[0] < 0:
                    points.append(f"Largest fall: **{change.index[0]}** ({number(change.iloc[0])}).")
    elif TIME and periods:
        points.append(f"**{first}** in {label(periods[0])}: **{number(combine(timed, '_period', first).iloc[0])}**.")
    if MAIN:
        latest = timed[timed["_period"] == periods[-1]] if TIME and periods else table
        top = combine(latest, MAIN, first).sort_values(ascending=False)
        if len(top):
            where = f" in {label(periods[-1])}" if TIME and periods else ""
            points.append(f"Largest {MAIN}{where}: **{top.index[0]}** ({number(top.iloc[0])} {first}).")
    warnings = checks[checks.status == "WARN"]
    if len(warnings):
        points.append(f"{len(warnings)} data check(s) need attention; see *What is in the file?* below.")
    print("\n".join(f"- {p}" for p in points) or "No clear points could be drawn from this table.")
```

## Automatic visual summary

```{python}
#| output: asis
# One headline chart, chosen from what the table holds (the same rules as the develop/v2.0.0 CSV route).
first = next(iter(MEASURES))
if TIME and periods:
    print('<p class="rule">Date or year + number → time trend.</p>\n')
    trend(timed, first)
elif MAIN:
    rule = "Category only → frequency bar chart." if first in COUNTED else "Category + number → ranked bar chart."
    print(f'<p class="rule">{rule}</p>\n')
    ranked(table, MAIN, first, f"{first} by {MAIN}")
elif len(REAL) >= 2:
    print('<p class="rule">Number + number → scatter plot.</p>\n')
    fig = figure(f"{REAL[1]} compared with {REAL[0]}", REAL[1], height=380)
    fig.add_scatter(x=table[REAL[0]], y=table[REAL[1]], mode="markers", marker=dict(color=h.BLUE, opacity=0.7))
    fig.update_layout(hovermode="closest")
    fig.update_xaxes(title=REAL[0])
    fig.show()
else:
    print('<p class="rule">Number only → distribution.</p>\n')
    histogram(table, first)
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
# Researcher view: how the table was read and checked, before the results.
def role(c):
    if c == TIME:
        return f"Time ({PERIOD}s)" if PERIOD else "Time"
    if c in MEASURES:
        return f"Number, {HOW[MEASURES[c]]}"
    if c in GROUPS:
        return "Group" + (" (main)" if c == MAIN else "")
    return "Not used"


columns = [c for c in raw.columns if c not in COUNTED]
if RESEARCH:
    print("\n\n## Your table\n\nHow each column was read. The charts use the time column for the x-axis, the number "
          "columns as values and the group columns to split them.\n")
    show(pd.DataFrame([{
        "Column": c, "Used as": role(c), "Type": str(raw[c].dtype),
        "Missing": f"{raw[c].isna().sum():,}", "Distinct values": f"{raw[c].nunique():,}",
        "Example": str(raw[c].dropna().iloc[0])[:40] if raw[c].notna().any() else "–",
    } for c in columns]))
    print("\nNumbers whose name suggests a level (rate, percent, share, average, index, price, ...) are averaged; "
          "all other numbers are treated as counts and added up."
          + (" The table has no number columns, so its rows are counted." if COUNTED else "") + "\n")
    print("\n\n## Data checks\n")
    show(checks.drop(columns=["dataset_id"]).rename(columns={"check": "Check", "status": "Result", "detail": "Detail"})
         .assign(Check=lambda f: f.Check.str.replace("_", " ").str.capitalize()))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
for i, measure in enumerate(list(MEASURES)[:6 if RESEARCH else 3]):
    how = MEASURES[measure]
    print(f"\n\n## {measure}\n")
    print(f"Values {HOW[how]} {'per ' + PERIOD if TIME else 'over all rows'}.\n")
    if TIME and periods:
        total = combine(timed, "_period", measure)
        latest, previous = total.iloc[-1], (total.iloc[-2] if len(total) > 1 else None)
        print(f"Latest {PERIOD} ({label(total.index[-1])}): **{number(latest)}**"
              + (f", {percent(latest, previous)} against {label(total.index[-2])}." if previous is not None else ".")
              + "\n")
        if i:  # the first one is the headline chart above
            trend(timed, measure)
        if MAIN:
            by = combine(timed, [MAIN, "_period"], measure).unstack(MAIN)
            top = combine(timed, MAIN, measure).sort_values(ascending=False).index[:8]
            fig = figure(f"{measure} by {MAIN}" + (f" (largest {len(top)})" if by.shape[1] > len(top) else ""),
                         measure, height=380)
            for colour, group in zip(PALETTE, top):
                fig.add_scatter(x=[label(p) for p in by.index], y=by[group], mode="lines+markers", name=str(group),
                                line=dict(color=colour, width=2))
            fig.update_xaxes(type="category", nticks=12)
            fig.show()
            last, before = by.index[-1], (by.index[-2] if len(by.index) > 1 else None)
            change = pd.DataFrame({MAIN: by.columns, "latest": by.loc[last].values,
                                   "previous": by.loc[before].values if before is not None else None})
            change = change.sort_values("latest", ascending=False).head(15)
            print(f"\n**{label(last)} against {label(before) if before is not None else '–'}, by {MAIN}**\n")
            show(pd.DataFrame({
                MAIN: change[MAIN],
                label(before) if before is not None else "Previous": change["previous"].map(number),
                label(last): change["latest"].map(number),
                "Change": [number(n - o) if pd.notna(o) and pd.notna(n) else "–"
                           for n, o in zip(change.latest, change.previous)],
                "Change %": [percent(n, o) for n, o in zip(change.latest, change.previous)],
            }))
    elif MAIN and i:
        ranked(table, MAIN, measure, f"{measure} by {MAIN}")
    elif not MAIN and i and measure not in COUNTED:
        histogram(table, measure)
    for other in GROUPS[1:3]:
        split = combine(table, other, measure).sort_values(ascending=False).head(15)
        print(f"\n**{measure} by {other}**" + (" (largest 15)" if len(split) == 15 else "") + "\n")
        show(pd.DataFrame({other: split.index, measure: split.map(number).values,
                           "Share": (split / split.sum()).map(lambda s: f"{s:.0%}").values
                           if how == "sum" and split.sum() else "–"}))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
# Statistics: every one for researchers (also saved as summary.csv), the main ones for public health.
stats = pd.DataFrame([{
    "Number column": m, "How combined": HOW[how], "Values": int(table[m].notna().sum()),
    "Missing": int(table[m].isna().sum()), "Average": table[m].mean(), "Std. deviation": table[m].std(),
    "Minimum": table[m].min(), "25%": table[m].quantile(0.25), "Median": table[m].median(),
    "75%": table[m].quantile(0.75), "Maximum": table[m].max(),
    "Total": table[m].sum() if how == "sum" else None,
} for m, how in MEASURES.items() if m not in COUNTED])
stats.to_csv("summary.csv", index=False)
if len(stats):
    print("\n\n## " + ("Summary statistics" if RESEARCH else "Main numeric findings") + "\n")
    keep = list(stats.columns) if RESEARCH else ["Number column", "Values", "Average", "Minimum", "Maximum"]
    shown = stats[keep].copy()
    for c in shown.columns[1:]:
        if c not in ("How combined",):
            shown[c] = shown[c].map(number)
    show(shown)
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
if RESEARCH and TIME:
    print("\n\n## Time structure\n")
    counts = timed.groupby("_period").size()
    expected = pd.period_range(periods[0], periods[-1], freq=freq).to_timestamp() if periods else []
    gaps = [p for p in expected if p not in set(counts.index)]
    unread = int(raw[TIME].isna().sum()) if TIME in raw else 0
    print(f"- Time column: **{TIME}**, read as {PERIOD}s.\n"
          f"- Covered: {span} ({len(periods)} {PERIOD}s with data).\n"
          f"- {PERIOD.capitalize()}s without any rows inside that span: **{len(gaps)}**"
          + (f" (first: {', '.join(label(g) for g in gaps[:5])})" if gaps else "") + ".\n"
          f"- Rows per {PERIOD}: {counts.min():,} to {counts.max():,}.\n"
          f"- Rows without a readable time: {unread:,} (left out of the charts over time).\n")
    if MAIN and periods:
        first = next(iter(MEASURES))
        pivot = combine(timed, [MAIN, "_period"], first).unstack("_period")
        pivot = pivot[pivot.columns[-8:]]
        pivot = pivot.loc[pivot[pivot.columns[-1]].sort_values(ascending=False).index].head(20)
        print(f"\n**{first} by {MAIN} and {PERIOD}**, the latest {len(pivot.columns)} {PERIOD}s"
              + (", largest 20" if len(pivot) == 20 else "") + ".\n")
        out = pivot.apply(lambda col: col.map(number))
        out.columns = [label(p) for p in out.columns]
        show(out.reset_index())
elif not RESEARCH:
    print("\n\n## What is in the file?\n")
    show(pd.DataFrame([{
        "Field": c, "Used as": role(c), "Missing values": f"{raw[c].isna().sum():,}",
        "Different values": f"{raw[c].nunique():,}"} for c in columns]))
    warnings = checks[checks.status == "WARN"]
    if len(warnings):
        print("\n**Checks that need attention**\n")
        print("\n".join(f"- {r.detail[0].upper() + r.detail[1:]}" for r in warnings.itertuples()) + "\n")
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
if RESEARCH:
    print("\n\n## Methods\n\n"
          "1. The file was read as it is; the column separator was detected from its first line.\n"
          "2. A column named like a year with whole numbers became the time; otherwise the first column whose values "
          "read as dates (90% or more) did.\n"
          "3. Columns whose values read as numbers (95% or more) became number columns, except codes such as "
          "`id`, `zip` or `code`. Text columns with 2 to 200 different values became groups.\n"
          f"4. Numbers were {'added up or averaged' if len(set(MEASURES.values())) > 1 else HOW[next(iter(MEASURES.values()))]} "
          "per period and group, as listed under *Your table*.\n"
          "5. Nothing was added that the file does not contain: no populations, rates, thresholds or disease "
          "classifications.\n")
else:
```

## Provenance

```{python}
#| output: asis
source = RESULTS / "table.csv"
here = Path.cwd()
record = {
    "report": "general.qmd",
    "audience": AUDIENCE,
    "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
    "source": f"Uploaded table {info['name']}, supplied by the reader.",
    "input": {"file": info["name"], "sha256": info["sha256"], "bytes": info["bytes"], "rows": info["rows"],
              "uploaded_at": info["uploaded_at"], "prepared_by": "scripts/health_pipeline/general_table.py",
              "prepared_table_sha256": sha256(source)},
    "columns": profile,
    "report_parameters": {"audience": AUDIENCE, "years": list(YEARS) if YEARS else "all",
                          (MAIN or "group"): CHOSEN or "all"},
    "quality_checks": {k: int(v) for k, v in checks.status.value_counts().items()},
    "code": {name: sha256(here / name) for name in ["general.qmd", "helpers.py", "provenance.py"]
             if (here / name).is_file()},
    "git": git(),
    "environment": {"python": platform.python_version(), "pandas": pd.__version__, "plotly": plotly.__version__,
                    "quarto": _run(["quarto", "--version"]), "platform": platform.platform()},
}
text = json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n"
(here / "provenance_general.json").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
download = "data:application/json;base64," + base64.b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
facts = [
    ("Source", record["source"]),
    ("Uploaded (UTC)", info["uploaded_at"]),
    ("Input checksum (SHA-256)", f"`{info['sha256']}`"),
    ("Rows and columns", f"{info['rows']:,} rows, {len(columns)} columns"),
    ("Report parameters", "<br>".join(f"{k}: {', '.join(v) if isinstance(v, list) and k != 'years' else v}"
                                      for k, v in record["report_parameters"].items())),
    ("Quality checks", ", ".join(f"{n} {s}" for s, n in sorted(record["quality_checks"].items()))),
    ("Code version (git commit)", f"`{record['git']['commit']}`"
     + (" plus uncommitted changes" if record["git"]["uncommitted_changes"] else "")),
    ("Tools", f"Python {record['environment']['python']}, pandas {pd.__version__}, plotly {plotly.__version__}, "
              f"Quarto {record['environment']['quarto']}"),
    ("Report generated (UTC)", record["generated_at"]),
]
print("| Item | Value |\n|---|---|\n" + "\n".join(f"| {k} | {v} |" for k, v in facts))
print("\n\nThe full machine-readable record can be saved as a file: "
      f'<a download="provenance_general.json" href="{download}">download provenance_general.json</a>. '
      "The rows used and the summary statistics are saved next to the report as CSV files.\n")
print("<details><summary>Full provenance record (JSON)</summary>\n\n```json\n" + text + "```\n\n</details>\n")
```
